hints.title: State Representation
hints.text: The matrix dimensions are small, at most 3 by 3. Encode the entire grid into an integer bitmask of at most 9 bits.

hints.title: Flipping a Cell
hints.text: Flipping cell (r, c) flips itself and its orthogonal neighbors. Precompute the flip mask for every possible position.

hints.title: Shortest Path Search
hints.text: Use level-by-level exploration starting from the initial matrix bitmask to reach mask 0, tracking visited states.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all permutations of flips leads to combinatorial explosion without cycle detection.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bitmask encoding enables O(1) state transitions and compact visited tracking in 2^9 states.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate notices the tiny grid dimensions (M, N <= 3) and applies bitmask BFS.
complexity.notes: Total states are at most 2^9 = 512, making BFS extremely fast.
